issue_context.title: Can't enable shelly device password authentication
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I have integrated my shelly device in home assistant and it is working nicely.

As the next step i wanted to enable password protection on the shelly and as soon as i do that, there is no more new data in home assistant.

Obviously i'd need to setup a password for home assistant to gather the metrics, however there does not seem to be an edit button to change the setup for that.

My ticket for documenting this has been instant closed and i've been forwarded here.

refs: https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/issues/23898

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.8.7

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Shelly

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/shelly/

### Diagnostics information

[config_entry-shelly-95909351f05172e04d941d4ca0b6935e.json.txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/9434985/config_entry-shelly-95909351f05172e04d941d4ca0b6935e.json.txt)


### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

_No response_

<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>
